title: FR: Actrapid as basal insulin
symptom: The user requests that Actrapid insulin be supported as a basal insulin in xDrip's prediction simulation, with a blue pipette/dropper icon and the ability to use the Basal Activity feature. The user states that all their compensation is based on this.
evidence_quote: I need very much: 1. Actrapid as basal (in prediction simulation) should have blue pipette/dropper (like other [more long-acting] basal insulins) — so, there will be indication/difference of another (basal) insulin with certain units specified. 2. Use Basal Activity ("Plot basal activity on graph and incorporate in predictive model") checkpoint should work with Actrapid as basal.
